chars.M: MERYEM: a young woman wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers, always sitting in a black manual wheelchair
chars.Y: YASSINE: a young man wearing a red bomber jacket over a white t-shirt, black jeans and grey sneakers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Exterior of a modern café terrace on the Ain Diab corniche in Casablanca in the late afternoon, the ocean in the background. MERYEM rolls her wheelchair toward the café, nervous but hopeful, while YASSINE stands near a table looking at his phone.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a bright Casablanca café with zellige tiles, YASSINE sits at a small table waiting, then notices MERYEM arriving in her wheelchair; he freezes in surprise.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside the café, YASSINE half rises from his chair, unsure and awkward, hands hovering, while MERYEM in her wheelchair looks up at him beside the table.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside the café, YASSINE bends down awkwardly to greet MERYEM who sits in her wheelchair, both a little embarrassed.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: At the café table, YASSINE and MERYEM sit facing each other with two coffee cups, an awkward silence, YASSINE scratching his head, confused, MERYEM looking down.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: At the café table, YASSINE and MERYEM laugh together over coffee and pastries, relaxed and happy, warm light.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night street in Casablanca with a red petit taxi stopped at the curb, YASSINE holds the taxi door open and helps MERYEM next to her wheelchair, street lamps glowing.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, MERYEM alone in her small bedroom in her wheelchair, holding her phone and staring at the screen, worried and anxious, soft lamp light.
